title: June 20, 2005 Austin City Council Special Called Meeting (Oaths of Office)
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting (Oaths of Office)
transcript:
Austin City Council
NOTICE OF SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Monday, June 20, 2005
THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS WILL
CONVENE AT 6:00 PM ON MONDAY, JUNE 20, 2005, IN THE
COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL, 301 WEST 2ND STREET,
AUSTIN, TEXAS.
The City Council wilt go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government
Code to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to
discuss personnel matters, to discuss or take action on a "competitive matter" of Austin
Energy as provided for under Section 551 086, or for other reasons permitted by law as
specifically listed on this agenda. If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed
session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda
City Clerk's Office
1 Administer the Oath of Office to the newly elected Council Members for Place 1, Place
3, and Place 4 of the City Council
2 Select Mayor Pro Tem
THE CITY OF AUSTIN IS COMMITTED TO COMPLIANCE WITH THE AMERICANS WITH
DISABILITIES ACT REASONABLE MODIFICATIONS AND EQUAL ACCESS TO
COMMUNICATIONS WILL BE PROVIDED UPON REQUEST FOR ASSISTANCE PLEASE
CALL 974-3256 OR 974-2445 TDD
A person may request a Spanish language interpreter be made available by contacting the
City Clerk's Office at 974-2210 no later than three hours before the scheduled time of the
item on which the person wishes to speak at the council meeting
Cualquier persona puede soltcitar servicios de interprete en espahol comunicandose con
la oficina del Secretano/a Municipal al 974-2210 a no mas tardar de tres horas antes de la
hora determmada para el asunto sobre el cual la persona desea comentar en la sesion del
Consejo.
